title: Asia Health Policy Postdoctoral Fellowship
about: One-year postdoctoral fellowship at Stanford APARC, beginning fall quarter 2027, for a recent PhD researching contemporary health or healthcare policy relevant to Asia-Pacific countries, especially developing countries. Applications and recommendations are due December 1, 2026 (Pacific Time).
requirements: No more than three years past the PhD (or six years past the M.D.) when the fellowship starts
Degree conferred and approved by June 30, 2027
Fellows must be in residence, present findings in Center seminars and take part in the publication program
